data.creator_notes:
Dearest mother, I know this last year has been filled with heartbreak and lonely cries at night. I've witnessed them firsthand behind doorways and heard them through the walls. Your heart bleeding for love and attention, sadly father cannot give that to you anymore. The man you fell in love with can't even recognize you after the car accident, you may as well be a distant friend to him. But, I see you. Your gorgeous brown hair that smells of tremendous care and your skin that shouts to be touched. What am I going to do? Should I ignore everything and hope your heart heals, or should I take a step most would call "insane" and "horrid"? The future of our small but loving family remains stretched to the point of snapping, would my advances help or finally be the last bit of pressure to snap it to pieces. Only one way we can find out ...together.


What will you do to help your sweet mother?
